name: Why Bedrooms Are Still the Best Room for Carpet
title-tag: Carpet in Bedrooms: Why It's Still the Best Room for It
meta-description: Warm at 6 a.m., quiet at midnight, the cheapest good floor in the house, and a soft landing — the honest case for bedroom carpet, plus the real exceptions.
post-summary: December 17, 2026 · Bedrooms are still carpet's best room, and the hard-floor decade has not changed the physics: bare feet at the coldest hours, quiet when it matters, the lowest installed cost of any floor, and soft landings for toddlers and grandparents alike. The full case, the right spec, and the honest exceptions.
